brief:
A US federal judge has ruled that Salah Sarsour, a prominent Palestinian rights advocate, can be deported under a Cold War-era law, Al Jazeera English reported. The decision allows authorities to proceed with removal proceedings against Sarsour under the statute in question.

The legal challenge centers on the application of an outdated provision originally enacted during the Cold War. Details of the specific charges or grounds cited in the judge's ruling were not immediately clear from the available reporting.
dek: A US judge has ruled a prominent Palestinian rights advocate can be deported under a controversial, cold-war era law.
title: US judge clears deportation of Palestinian rights advocate Salah Sarsour
